# Cofkans Electricals

Cofkans Electricals provides lighting and electrical products for homes and businesses in Ghana.

The customer portal supports product browsing, customer accounts, carts, checkout, order history, wishlists, delivery information, installation information, branch details, and customer support.

The main showroom is Cofkans Asuoyeboa Showroom in Asuoyeboa, Kumasi. Branch information is available at /branches.

The public production domain has not been configured yet, so canonical URLs are intentionally omitted from this staging build.
